marketing_description: The DeWALT MAX XR® Double Bevel Sliding Miter Saw (DCS785B) delivers a 12‑in steel blade with a 14‑in cutting height and 6‑1/2‑in cutting width, supporting 22.5° and 33.9° bevel angles for precise miter and bevel cuts. Powered by a 20 V MAX Lithium‑Ion battery with variable speed control, the saw features regenerative braking, a bevel‑gear transmission, and integrated wireless tool control, while its metal housing, black finish, and rubber carry handle provide durable handling. It captures up to 97 % of dust and can complete up to 371 cuts in 3 ¼‑in. MDF base molding or 153 cuts in pressure‑treated 4 × 4 timber.
